description: We are in it to win it, So join if serious
summary:
LAST SIGNAL is a game where you play as one of six astronauts. You are in a spacecraft called AURORA-7. Something goes wrong. You have to land on Mars. You travel to a research place. You fix the life-support systems. You look into a signal. The signal is linked to NASA’s Opportunity rover.

You pick one of six jobs. The jobs are Commander, Pilot, Engineer, Scientist, Medic and EVA Specialist. You take care of oxygen, power, water, food, radiation and suit safety. You see how each part affects the others. There is a helper inside the spacecraft called AURA. After the game ends there is a Mission Rewind report. The report shows what you did and what happened because of your choices.

The game uses NASA and USGS data. It also uses the Opportunity rover model. The systems in the game are based on engineering. The goal is to teach science through fun. It wants to encourage children who want to be astronauts. It shows them what it is, like to work and live on another planet. Explore, Survive, Repair, Discover, Learn.
details:
Last Signal : Mars Expedition is a first‑person, cooperative Mars survival game that shows how astronauts live and work off‑world. Six players take roles such as Commander, Engineer, Medic and EVA Specialist aboard the spacecraft AURORA‑7. After a mid‑flight emergency they land on Mars travel to a research outpost restore its life‑support systems and investigate a signal linked to NASA’s Opportunity rover.

Oxygen, CO₂, power, water, food, radiation and suit systems all affect each other so players learn cause and effect by making choices and seeing the results. An onboard helper, AURA guides them and a Mission Rewind report explains the outcome.

Our goal is to inspire children who dream of becoming astronauts but do not know what life on another planet involves. They get to experience it.

We used Three.js and Godot 4.7.2 NASA/USGS terrain data (HiRISE and MOLA) and NASA’s official Opportunity model. The engineering systems are models and the story elements are fictional.

We considered accuracy, teamwork, accessibility and solo playability.
